name: Octive
summary: Octive is a free vertical scrolling rhythm game (VSRG). Notes scroll down lanes toward a judgement line, and the player presses the matching keys in time with the music. Charts can use from 1 to 20 keys. The game can import and download osu!mania beatmaps and includes a chart editor for making custom charts. Online features include multiplayer rooms, spectating friends, global leaderboards with a performance rating (PR), Dan courses, daily charts, and a Workshop for sharing charts, skins, themes and styles.
